# Upstream ListenBrainz JSONL sample

`upstream.jsonl` is the unmodified two-row fixture from
[listenbrainz/testdata/listenbrainz_listens.jsonl](https://github.com/metabrainz/listenbrainz-server/blob/61ef77e4a7b2fd962943c56ba765d34fa8483ce8/listenbrainz/testdata/listenbrainz_listens.jsonl)
at revision `61ef77e4a7b2fd962943c56ba765d34fa8483ce8` (MetaBrainz ListenBrainz server,
[GPL-2.0-or-later notice](https://github.com/metabrainz/listenbrainz-server/blob/61ef77e4a7b2fd962943c56ba765d34fa8483ce8/README.md#license-notice)).

It exercises source metadata, mapping enrichment, recording MSID placement and durations.
Tests build ZIP/JSON/API wrappers from these actual JSONL rows and use synthetic rows for
edge cases. The ZIP wrapper generated by tests is not a downloaded authenticated export.
